Advent Defense League
https://www.youtube.com/@AdventDefenseLeague/videos

What if deception doesn’t look like deception at all?
In Episode 247 we uncover how truth mixed with error becomes one of the most dangerous tools of the enemy. From the Garden of Eden to modern Christianity, spiritualism has taken many subtle forms—often disguised as light. Many practices that seem harmless—or even spiritual—may actually open doors to deception. 
We join up with the guys from Advent Defense League for this important discussion.
